claims.claim: Cleanly used Electric bike for sale
claims.evidence: Photo shows no visible damage, but general 'cleanliness' and usage history cannot be judged from one static shot.
No battery label, compartment, or spec plate visible in the photo.
No receipt, purchase date, or documentation shown.
Photo is static; no test ride, brake lever, or gear mechanism close-up shown.
Photo shows intact paint and no visible dents, but rust on undercarriage, battery compartment, or hidden bolts cannot be confirmed from a single front/side view.

risks.risk: Battery health and real capacity unknown (critical for an EV's value)
risks.proof: Photo/video of battery voltage reading under load, or a short ride showing range display
risks.if_unproven: price as a unit needing battery replacement/refurbishment

risks.risk: Actual age and mileage unverifiable; '6 months old' is a seller claim only
risks.proof: Odometer photo or original purchase receipt with date
risks.if_unproven: price as an older/higher-mileage unit, not as near-new

risks.risk: Mechanical condition of brakes, motor, suspension untested
risks.proof: Short video clip of the scooter being ridden, braking, and accelerating

risks.risk: Missing accessories (charger, keys, manual) not shown
risks.proof: Photo of charger, keys, and manual laid out together with the scooter

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on frame/undercarriage/battery box not visible from given angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, underside, and battery compartment

risks.risk: Brand/model unidentified, affecting part availability and resale value
risks.proof: Clear photo of nameplate, VIN sticker, or model badge
risks.if_unproven: price at generic/unbranded electric scooter tier

proof_requests: Clear photo of battery label/spec plate
Photo or video of odometer/mileage display
Short video of scooter running, braking, and accelerating
Photo of charger, keys, and any documents together with the bike
Close-up photos of frame underside and battery compartment for rust check
Clear photo of brand/model nameplate or VIN
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an electric scooter in apparently intact external condition, so it can be priced at worst case for unverifiable battery, age, and mechanical claims, pending the listed proofs.
